description: The chart illustrates Recall@10 values for several methods, shown as a vertical bar chart with method categories on the horizontal axis and Recall@10 on the vertical axis. The x-axis lists four categories in left-to-right order: “Ours,” “_critiquing,” “_scoring,” and “_ranking,” with labels angled; there is no separate x-axis title visible. The y-axis is labeled “Recall@10” (also shown prominently near the top) and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick marks at approximately 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. There are four single bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches just under 0.4 (approximately 0.38); “_critiquing” is blue and is slightly above 0.3 (around 0.34–0.35); “_scoring” is blue and is near the mid-0.2 range (about 0.25); and “_ranking” is blue and is around the mid-0.3 range (approximately 0.35). The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being separate categories, and no legend is shown; the “Ours” bar is visually emphasized by its distinct orange color while the others share the same blue color, and the categories appear in a fixed left-to-right order rather than being explicitly sorted by value.
